scenario: A dead function is appended to a list via an AugAssign (HANDLERS += [vulnerable]) -- probes the DECISIONS.md §5.3 narrowing's explicitly-covered AugAssign case, untested by any existing fixture.
human_note: vulnerable is never called anywhere, but HANDLERS += [vulnerable] value-binds it as a direct element of a list literal on the RHS of an AugAssign. _LoadOutsideCallCollector.visit_AugAssign calls _record_value_bound on the RHS, which recurses into the list literal's elements, so 'vulnerable' is recorded as escaped.
